image_description: A cooked Dungeness crab presented on a white plate. The crab exhibits a reddish-orange carapace with mottled patterns, typical of cooked crustaceans. Two large claws (chelipeds) are visible in the foreground, appearing robust with dark tips. Several walking legs extend laterally from the body. The background shows a blurred table setting with a glass.
